title: Divergent humidity-driven growth in urban air-conditioning energy demand under climate change
summary: Investigates the role of changing humidity in urban air-conditioning demand using coupled building energy and Earth system modelling.

title: Making intra-urban monitoring ‘a walk in the park’: A mobile monitoring approach for assessing pedestrians’ environmental conditions
summary: Develops and pilots a mobile monitoring system for studying pedestrian thermal conditions and air quality across urban environments.

title: Gap filling crowdsourced air temperature data in cities using data-driven approaches
summary: Evaluates data-driven methods for reconstructing missing urban temperature observations from citizen weather stations.

title: Could residential air-source heat pumps exacerbate outdoor summer overheating and winter overcooling in UK 2050s climate scenarios?
summary: Uses SUEWS–EnergyPlus modelling to examine how residential heat pumps alter neighbourhood heat emissions and outdoor temperatures in future UK climate scenarios.

title: Spatial and temporal variation of anthropogenic heat emissions in Colombo, Sri Lanka
summary: Estimates the spatial and daily variation of heat released by buildings, transport and people in Colombo, with scenarios for future emissions.

title: Impact of building density on natural ventilation potential and cooling energy saving across Chinese climate zones
summary: Examines how neighbourhood density and local weather change simulated ventilation potential and cooling savings across five Chinese climate zones.

title: Use of wind pressure coefficients to simulate natural ventilation and building energy for isolated and surrounded buildings
summary: Studies how wind-pressure coefficients and reference wind speeds influence simulations of ventilation, overheating and cooling energy use.

title: Impact of inter-building longwave radiative exchanges on building energy performance and indoor overheating
summary: Represents radiative exchange with surrounding buildings to assess its effects on simulated energy performance and indoor overheating.

title: Urban meteorological forcing data for building energy simulations
summary: Combines ERA5 and SUEWS to create neighbourhood-specific weather inputs and vertical profiles for building energy simulation.

title: Impact of neighbourhood-scale climate characteristics on building heating demand and night ventilation cooling potential
summary: Combines a year of fixed-station weather observations with building simulation to assess local climate effects on heating demand and night-ventilation cooling potential.
